ui_worker.prompt: Read spec.md. Edit only app/toolbar.js; implement renderToolbar(preferences). Report actual changes and checks. Do not commit or push.

storage_worker.prompt: Read spec.md. Edit only app/settings.js; implement loadPreferences(storage) and savePreferences(storage, preferences). Report actual changes and checks. Do not commit or push.

integrator.prompt: Read spec.md and both worker reports. Edit only app/main.js to wire preferences, controls and drawing. Report actual changes and checks. Do not commit or push.

reviewer.prompt: Read spec.md and the app. Make no edits. Report supported findings with file evidence. You cannot run shell checks; say so. Browser acceptance requires observing the app.
